source.title: A plugged-in appliance nearly caused a house fire.
source.description:
In the early hours of the morning, a family woke up to the smell of smoke after an electrical appliance reportedly exploded. The incident was captured on CCTV, and their quick response helped prevent what could have been a devastating fire.

Thankfully, everyone was safe. 🙏

This is an important reminder: never ignore safety at home, especially electrical safety

Before sleeping or leaving your home:
Unplug appliances that don't need to stay connected.
Check plugs, cords and outlets for overheating or damage.
Avoid overloading extension boards and sockets.
Never ignore sparks, smoke, burning smells or unusual buzzing sounds.

Electrical issues can pose serious risks at home. A professional home inspection can help identify electrical defects that need attention.

Stay safe. Protect your home before small issues become serious problems.
